summary.motive: Guarantee zero yards on third-and-short by sending both mugged backers through the only gaps the offense must block, converting a run-stuffing front into instant pass overload.
summary.keyDefender: WILL over the strong A-gap — the guard assigned to him cannot get square before the knife arrives
summary.whyItWorks: The Bear wall occupies all five blockers, so each mugged backer meets only one scanning back, and island press delays every perimeter answer past the pressure clock.
summary.failureMode: An instant RPO or slant thrown on rhythm before either mugged backer clears the guards’ hands.

beats.title: 1. The Mug Picture
beats.text: MIKE and WILL stand upright directly over both A-gaps at 1.2 yards with the safety crowding the box and only the free safety deep. Six protectors must account for seven immediate threats.

beats.title: 2. Same-Gap Knives Behind the Wall
beats.text: Both backers cross the guards’ inside shoulders simultaneously while the zero-nose drives the center and both 4is angle into the B gaps behind them.

beats.title: 3. The Hot Window Never Opens
beats.text: The designed hot slant to H demands the ball out in 1.5 seconds, but the scanning back took the wrong knife and WILL has already cleared the guard’s hands.

beats.title: 4. Swallowed on Third-and-One
beats.text: The free-runner hit from strong A buries the QB behind the line of scrimmage and forces the long field-goal unit onto the field.

relations.tell: Both linebackers stand upright directly over the guards staring at the QB at 1.2 yards — the goal-line Bear keeps its backers at 3.4 yards in downhill run fits.
